ev = None
found = None
for seg in range(1, 16):
    g = primitives.call(name='ground_robocasa_visual_target', entity_name='drawer_obj',
                        camera_name='robot0_agentview_left', segmentation_id=seg)
    if g.ok:
        found = g
        if isinstance(g.output, dict) and g.output.get('evidence_handle'):
            ev = g.output.get('evidence_handle')
        break
print("FOUND", found is not None, "EV", ev)

if ev:
    m = primitives.call(name='move_robocasa_ee_to', evidence_handles=[ev], target_name='drawer_obj',
                        offset=[0.0, -0.16, 0.02], gripper_command=1.0, horizon=80)
    print("MOVE", m.ok)
    t = primitives.call(name='inspect_robocasa_transport_state', object_name='drawer_obj')

    d = primitives.call(name='observe_robocasa_rgbd', camera_name='robot0_agentview_left')
    print("RGBD", d.ok)
